purpose: Separate load-amplitude bias from spatial support recovery; compare matched inverse objectives, not forward speed alone

calibration_reference.inputs: Same noisy observations; true applied force multipliers supplied as calibrated input. No true support access. Explicit privileged-input reference, not an operational competitor.
calibration_reference.selection: Same starts, penalty path and discrepancy rule as H1 methods

optimizers.selection: Largest successful penalty with whitened training residual norm <= 1.2*sqrt(N); flag if none or unbracketed
optimizers.pilot_note: Pilot on a separate smooth Gaussian and a different noise seed may revise numerical tolerances/path or mesh, never tune on scored test truths. Freeze effective protocol with hashes before full run. Preserve amendments.

same_objective_check.penalty: H1 at selected profile lambda; report start and total timings separately

reporting: All methods on all cases; successes and failures; noise ranges not confidence intervals; no universal repair or excavation threshold; same-objective projection does not add information or guarantee accuracy gains
